text:
### 3. Account Balance Issues  
**Example:** Missing credit, wrong balance shown, interest miscalculated  
**Investigation:**
- Reconcile transactions
- Check system records
- Verify calculations
- Review any hold periods  
**Resolution:**
- If bank error: Correct balance + interest on missing amount
- If customer misunderstanding: Explain (educate, don't penalize)
- If system error: Urgent IT escalation to fix
name: Chunk 18/38

raw_entities.name: Account Balance Issue Resolution Mandate
raw_entities.description: Establishes a mandatory investigative and resolution framework for account balance discrepancies. Requires staff to reconcile transactions, verify system records and calculations, and review hold periods before applying corrective measures based on the root cause (bank error, customer misunderstanding, or system failure).
context: - If bank error: Correct balance + interest on missing amount
- If customer misunderstanding: Explain (educate, don't penalize)
- If system error: Urgent IT escalation to fix

raw_entities.name: Transaction Reconciliation Process
raw_entities.description: Mandates the systematic reconciliation of all relevant transactions to identify and resolve discrepancies in account balances. Serves as a primary control measure for detecting missing credits or miscalculations.

raw_entities.name: System Record Verification & Calculation Audit
raw_entities.description: Requires staff to cross-reference system-generated records and independently verify mathematical calculations to ensure data integrity and accurate balance reporting.

raw_entities.name: Hold Period Review Protocol
raw_entities.description: Mandates the review of all applicable transaction hold periods to determine if temporary balance restrictions are causing apparent discrepancies.

raw_entities.name: Balance Correction & Interest Adjustment Procedure
aliases: Correct balance + interest on missing amount
raw_entities.description: Requires immediate correction of account balances and the application of compensatory interest on missing amounts when a bank processing error is confirmed.
context: - If bank error: Correct balance + interest on missing amount

raw_entities.name: Customer Education & Non-Penalisation Protocol
raw_entities.description: Mandates a customer-centric resolution approach for misunderstandings, requiring staff to explain discrepancies and educate customers without applying penalties.
context: - If customer misunderstanding: Explain (educate, don't penalize)

raw_entities.name: Urgent IT Escalation Mechanism
raw_entities.description: Requires immediate escalation to the IT department to resolve technical failures or system errors that impact account balance accuracy.
context: - If system error: Urgent IT escalation to fix

raw_entities.name: Operational & System Error Risk
raw_entities.description: Covers risks arising from processing mistakes, mathematical miscalculations, or system failures that result in incorrect account balances, missing credits, or unauthorized interest accrual.
context: Missing credit, wrong balance shown, interest miscalculated

raw_entities.name: Investigation & Resolution Staff
raw_entities.description: Assigned accountability for executing the investigation framework, including reconciling transactions, verifying records and calculations, reviewing hold periods, and applying appropriate resolution measures based on error classification.

raw_entities.name: Customer Account Subject to Balance Verification
raw_entities.description: The account entity subject to mandatory balance verification, reconciliation, and correction procedures. Requires accurate credit application, correct balance display, and proper interest calculation.

raw_entities.name: Credit Transaction Requiring Verification
raw_entities.description: Financial events involving credited funds that are subject to reconciliation and verification controls to ensure timely posting and accurate balance reporting.
